invoice-scams.title: Invoice and Payment Fraud
invoice-scams.intro: How attackers redirect a real payment to their own account — by changing bank details on an invoice, or a payroll record — and the two checks that stop it.

client-data.title: Secure Client Data Handling
client-data.intro: You hold the client files, the passwords and the access. The usual way all three get exposed is someone posing as your boss — here is how that works, and the one check that stops it whatever rank is on the message.

client-impersonation.title: Fake Clients and Escrow Fraud
client-impersonation.intro: How a fake client takes your login, your work or your money — and how to check who you are dealing with before you hand anything over.

fake-recruiters.title: Fake Job Offers
fake-recruiters.intro: How a fake recruiter collects your passport scan, your bank details and your money — and what to check before you send any of it.
